properties.notes: Creation of x4 'studio flats' and x2 one-bedroom flats (Class C3) and extended floorspace for the existing retail unit (Class A2) involving: _x000D_ the construction of a ground floor rear extension and a three-storeyed block above; _x000D_ the construction of a mansard roof on the existing three-storeyed main body of the building, with an associated three-storeyed rear stairwell block; _x000D_ the demolition of the existing (unlawful) first floor rear extension; _x000D_ the insertion of a new shopfront, and;_x000D_ the replacement of the existing front windows at first floor and second floor with timber-framed sash units.
